items.name: Signature Latte
items.shortDescription: Espresso poured into silky steamed milk, finished with a hand-poured swirl.
items.story: Slow-brewed coffee, rich aroma and a moment worth enjoying.
items.description: A double shot of freshly pulled espresso meets steamed milk and a layer of velvety foam. Poured slowly so the crema blooms into a swirl on top.
items.preparation: Espresso is pulled to order, milk is steamed until glossy, then poured in one continuous motion.

items.name: Classic Cheeseburger
items.shortDescription: A toasted sesame bun, a seared patty and cheese melted until it runs.
items.story: Stacked slowly, melted properly, and built to be held with both hands.
items.description: A seared patty under a blanket of melted cheese, layered with crisp lettuce, tomato slices and a house sauce, all inside a soft toasted bun.
items.preparation: Patty seared on a hot griddle, cheese melted on top, assembled while warm.

items.name: Golden Puff Patty
items.shortDescription: Flaky layered pastry folded around a warm, spiced vegetable filling.
items.story: Layers of flaky pastry that shatter first and comfort second.
items.description: A bakery-style patty with a crisp, golden, many-layered crust. Break it open and the warm spiced filling is waiting inside.
items.preparation: Baked until the crust turns deep golden and crisp.

items.name: Wood-Fired Pepperoni Pizza
items.shortDescription: Tomato sauce, stretching mozzarella, pepperoni, olives and fresh basil.
items.story: A blistered crust, a warm sweep of sauce, and the pull of a perfect slice.
items.description: A hand-stretched base spread with tomato sauce and covered in cheese, topped with pepperoni, black olives and basil leaves.
items.preparation: Baked in a very hot oven until the crust blisters and the cheese bubbles.

items.name: Strawberry Milkshake
items.shortDescription: Cold milk blended with strawberries, crowned with whipped cream and chocolate.
items.story: Cold, thick, and swirled until the straw stands tall.
items.description: Milk blended with strawberry until pale pink and thick, finished with whipped cream, a chocolate drizzle and a strawberry on top.
items.preparation: Blended to order and served immediately.

items.name: Chocolate Éclair
items.shortDescription: A crisp choux shell piped with cream and dipped in glossy chocolate.
items.story: A crisp shell, a cloud of cream, and a glaze that catches the light.
items.description: A light choux pastry filled with sweet cream, glazed with dark chocolate and finished with crushed pistachio.
items.preparation: Shell baked crisp, filled with cream and dipped in glaze to set.

items.name: Layered Chocolate Cake
items.shortDescription: Chocolate sponge, cream layers, ganache and fresh strawberries.
items.story: Layer by layer, a slow celebration.
items.description: Three layers of chocolate sponge sandwiched with cream, covered in a glossy ganache and topped with strawberries. Priced per slice.
items.preparation: Layers assembled by hand, chilled to set, served by the slice.

items.name: Pink Glazed Donut
items.shortDescription: A soft ring donut with strawberry glaze, chocolate drizzle and sprinkles.
items.story: A glossy ring of sweetness, finished with a flourish of colour.
items.description: A pillowy fried donut dipped in pink glaze, striped with chocolate and scattered with colourful sprinkles.
items.preparation: Fried golden, dipped in glaze while warm, finished with toppings.

items.name: Garden Club Sandwich
items.shortDescription: Toasted bread layered with cheese, tomato, cucumber and crisp lettuce.
items.story: Toasted, stacked, and cut on the diagonal, because that's how it tastes best.
items.description: Grilled bread layered with lettuce, tomato, cucumber and cheese, cut in half and held together with a toothpick.
items.preparation: Bread toasted on a grill, layered cold and cut to order.

items.name: Crispy French Fries
items.shortDescription: Golden fries, salted while hot, with a ketchup dip.
items.story: Golden, salted while hot, gone before the conversation ends.
items.description: Thin-cut potatoes fried until golden and crisp, tossed with salt and served in a carton with ketchup.
items.preparation: Fried until crisp, salted straight from the fryer.

items.name: Glass-Brewed Tea
items.shortDescription: Tea leaves steeped in hot water in a glass, with a slice of lemon.
items.story: A quiet cup: leaves unfurling, colour blooming, time slowing down.
items.description: Tea leaves steeped in a clear glass so you can watch the colour bloom, served with a slice of lemon.
items.preparation: Steeped to order in a glass.

items.name: Iced Cold Coffee
items.shortDescription: Coffee poured over cold milk and ice, in layers.
items.story: Ice, milk and coffee in layers — meant to be admired for exactly one sip.
items.description: Cold milk and ice in a tall glass with chilled coffee poured over so the layers cascade, finished with cocoa dust.
items.preparation: Built in the glass, served with a straw.

items.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
items.shortDescription: Three cookies with soft centres, crisp edges and chocolate chunks.
items.story: Soft centres, crisp edges, and chocolate that never quite sets.
items.description: A plate of three cookies baked until golden at the edges, loaded with chocolate chips. Priced per plate.

items.name: Fudge Brownies
items.shortDescription: Dense chocolate brownies with walnuts, powdered sugar and warm sauce.
items.story: Dense, dark and dusted with sugar — a square of pure indulgence.
items.description: Rich, fudgy chocolate brownies cut into squares, topped with walnut pieces, dusted with powdered sugar and drizzled with chocolate sauce.
items.preparation: Baked in a tin, cooled, cut into squares and finished to order.

items.name: Triple Scoop Cone
items.shortDescription: Vanilla, strawberry and chocolate on a waffle cone, with sauce and a cherry.
items.story: Three scoops, one cone, and a race against the sun.
items.description: Three scoops — vanilla, strawberry and chocolate — stacked on a crisp waffle cone, with chocolate sauce and a cherry on top.
items.preparation: Scooped to order onto a fresh cone.

items.name: Garlic Bread
items.shortDescription: Sliced baguette brushed with garlic butter and scattered with parsley.
items.story: Warm from the oven, brushed with butter, torn apart without apology.
items.description: A baguette sliced and brushed with garlic butter, baked until the edges crisp, and finished with fresh parsley.
items.preparation: Sliced, buttered and baked until golden.
